name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering and kitchen system
promotionalText: Take orders ahead, stop orders the kitchen can’t handle, and keep trading even when the internet drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is an ordering and kitchen app for food trucks. It’s the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Staff see every order on one screen, confirm the orders the kitchen can cook, then mark them ready and picked up.

■ Don’t promise a time you can’t keep
Set how much the kitchen can cook at once and how long cooking takes. When a pickup time is full, customers can’t choose that time, so the order queue follows what the kitchen can do.

■ Take walk-up orders too
Add walk-up orders taken in front of the food truck to the same screen as the ordered-ahead ones, and the kitchen can work from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen display shows what to make now, what to make next and what is ready, and an alert sounds when there is an order you need to start cooking.

■ Order ticket printing
Connect the kitchen receipt printer by Bluetooth or local network, and order tickets print automatically.

■ Keep trading even when the internet drops
If you keep offline protection on, taking orders ahead pauses when the connection drops, so no order comes in that you can’t see. Orders taken on the device are saved and synced when you are online again.

■ Made for life on the food truck
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during trading, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan the week’s schedule
Set up events and locations just once and you can take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is an app for food truck operators and staff. A HatchGrab account is needed to log in.
